{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Sturdy leather armor''' is a stronger leather set crafted from [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. It has Projectile Protection, 2 safe fall distance per piece, and the boots add step height and [[Trailblaze]].

== Obtaining ==
The pieces are the [[Sturdy Leather Helmet|helmet]], [[Sturdy Leather Gambeson|gambeson]], [[Sturdy Leather Leggings|leggings]] and [[Sturdy Leather Boots|boots]]. They are repaired with tattered leather.

=== Village tannery chests ===
[[Village]] tannery chests can also hold a piece of sturdy leather armor.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/village/village_tannery.json}}</ref> In 1.12.2 these pieces are an older version of the set and differ from crafted ones:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref>
* They are invisible when worn. Their equipment asset is <code>minecraft:sturdy_leather</code>, but the resource pack defines the armor texture as <code>matcha:sturdy_leather</code>, so the game finds nothing to draw.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/matcha/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref>
* Each piece gives 1 block of safe fall distance instead of 2, the gambeson gives 4 armor instead of 5, and the boots have Feather Falling III and no extra step height.
* Each piece also rolls one random enchantment, which can repeat one it already has.
* They have no repair item of their own, so they are repaired with sturdy leather like ordinary [[leather armor]], not with tattered leather.
This is not fixed on the <code>main</code> branch either.
